title: Bag Items
summary: The non-cosmetic Bag items that are not one of the twelve gathering materials: per-gamemode trophy items, temporary coin boosts, the openable pocket bags and crates, their two keys, the two non-gathering crafting currencies (Cosmetic Shard, Stardust), and one souvenir (Beta Ticket). All of these are defined once in NetworkCore and are the same everywhere on the network. Cosmetics, Blueprint unlock items and the twelve gathering materials are documented separately. Every entry here is exhaustive and cross-checked against NetworkCore's live config.yml (backpack.items, loot-tables, drops, and quests sections) plus HubCore's docs/BAG.md - 22 entries total, up from the previous pass's 18 (the four new ones are Common Key, Rare Key, Cosmetic Shard and Stardust, none of which were catalogued before).

entries.name: Parkour Medal
entries.description: Awarded for clearing a hub parkour course.
entries.how_to_get: Reach 50 jumps in a single Hub parkour run.
entries.how_to_use: Kept in the Bag as a trophy; there is no action button for it.
entries.icon_hint: a small gold medallion on a ribbon, engraved with a running shoe or footprint
entries.notes: Non-stackable - only one copy can ever be held.

entries.name: Daily Charm
entries.description: A lucky charm from a daily chest.
entries.how_to_get: One of the six Daily Chest reward slots has an 85% chance of being a bag item instead of coins; the Daily Charm is the rarest possible outcome of that item roll (a 0.4-out-of-100 weight, versus 46 for a Small Pocket Bag) - roughly a 1-in-300 chance on any single Daily Chest claim.
entries.how_to_use: Kept in the Bag as a trophy; there is no action button for it.
entries.icon_hint: a small glowing purple amethyst shard shaped like a charm/pendant
entries.notes: Non-stackable - only one copy can ever be held.

entries.name: Coin Boost 1.5x
entries.description: Earn 1.5x coins from Hub activities for 30 minutes.
entries.how_to_get: A bonus-pool roll when opening a Large Pocket Bag, or one of the possible outcomes of a Common Crate's guaranteed bonus "chase" roll.
entries.how_to_use: Activate it from the Bag to start a 30-minute 1.5x coin multiplier. Activating a second one before it expires extends the remaining time rather than adding to the multiplier.
entries.icon_hint: a small pile of glittering white sugar-like crystals with a golden coin symbol floating above

entries.name: Coin Boost 2x
entries.description: Earn double coins from Hub activities for 30 minutes.
entries.how_to_get: One of the possible outcomes of a Rare Crate's guaranteed bonus "chase" roll - its only current source.
entries.how_to_use: Activate it from the Bag to start a 30-minute 2x coin multiplier. Activating a second one before it expires extends the remaining time rather than adding to the multiplier.
entries.icon_hint: a swirl of orange-red powder with bright coin sparks and a bold x2 glint

entries.name: Coin Boost 2x (2h)
entries.description: Earn double coins from Hub activities for two hours.
entries.how_to_get: The rarest of the possible outcomes of a Rare Crate's guaranteed bonus "chase" roll - currently its only source. No seasonal/event system exists on the network yet, so "events" is not (yet) an actual way to get this despite what older documentation suggested.
entries.how_to_use: Activate it from the Bag to start a 2-hour 2x coin multiplier. Activating a second one before it expires extends the remaining time rather than adding to the multiplier.
entries.icon_hint: a glowing golden teardrop-shaped gem with a bright aura, larger and fancier than the shorter boost icons

entries.name: Small Pocket Bag
entries.description: A little bundle. Open it and see.
entries.how_to_get: The everyday reward from the Daily Chest and general play - by far the most common bag item on the network. The heaviest-weighted entry in the Daily Chest's 85%-chance item-slot table, and the guaranteed or near-guaranteed reward-item on the great majority of Quest Board quests (a 60% chance on Easy-tier quests, guaranteed on Medium-tier daily quests).
entries.how_to_use: Open it from the Bag for a guaranteed handful of coins, with a smaller chance of some crafting materials and, rarely, a bonus key or Common Crate.
entries.icon_hint: a small tied cloth drawstring bundle/pouch in plain grey-brown cloth

entries.name: Large Pocket Bag
entries.description: Heavier than it looks.
entries.how_to_get: A less-common Daily Chest item-slot roll, and the guaranteed reward on some rolls of the every-5th-qualifying-run Diamond Trophy milestone (a Diamond Trophy run that actually cleared an act). Not currently a Quest Board reward or a Daily Chest streak-milestone reward, despite older documentation suggesting otherwise - streak milestones only ever pay a Common Crate (7-day streak) or Rare Crate (30-day streak).
entries.how_to_use: Open it from the Bag for more coins and two rolls of crafting materials, plus a decent chance at a bonus key, crate, or coin boost.
entries.icon_hint: a bulging, well-stuffed cloth drawstring bundle in blue cloth, larger than the small pocket bag

entries.name: Common Crate
entries.description: Needs a Common Key to open.
entries.how_to_get: Earned across the network: a possible Daily Chest item-slot roll, a bonus-pool roll from opening a pocket bag, the reward-items on Hard/Elite/community-tier Quest Board quests, the guaranteed reward on some rolls of the every-5th-qualifying-run Diamond Trophy milestone, and guaranteed once every 7-day Daily Chest claim streak.
entries.how_to_use: Open it (consumes one Common Key) for guaranteed coins, cosmetic-crafting shards and materials, plus a chance at a cosmetic or a bonus item. Trying to open one with no key just shows it locked.
entries.icon_hint: a plain wooden treasure chest with green metal trim

entries.name: Rare Crate
entries.description: Needs a Rare Key to open.
entries.how_to_get: A rarer reward for bigger milestones: a rare Daily Chest item-slot roll, the reward-items on Elite-tier Quest Board quests, and guaranteed once every 30-day Daily Chest claim streak.
entries.how_to_use: Open it (consumes one Rare Key) for a large coin payout, rare and epic crafting materials, and a guaranteed 'chase' bonus roll that can include a cosmetic. Trying to open one with no key just shows it locked.
entries.icon_hint: an ornate purple-and-black trimmed chest with a faint magical glow

entries.name: Common Key
entries.description: Opens one Common Crate. Has no other use.
entries.how_to_get: The most common of the two keys: a bonus-pool roll from opening a Small or Large Pocket Bag, a possible Daily Chest item-slot roll, a Common Crate's own guaranteed bonus 'chase' roll, the reward-items on Hard/Elite/community-tier Quest Board quests, the guaranteed reward on some rolls of the every-5th-qualifying-run Diamond Trophy milestone, or crafted instantly at the Crafting Altar for 4 Forged Steel + 30 Base Material (no altar slot/time cost - a pressure valve for when crates outnumber keys).
entries.how_to_use: Consumed automatically when you open a Common Crate from the Bag. Stacks freely.
entries.icon_hint: a small ornate key with a green-tinted handle
entries.notes: Also documented, with the same facts, in crates-and-keys.json.

entries.name: Rare Key
entries.description: Opens one Rare Crate. Has no other use.
entries.how_to_get: A rare bonus-pool roll from opening a Large Pocket Bag, a rare Daily Chest item-slot roll, a Rare Crate's own guaranteed bonus 'chase' roll, a 20% chance alongside Hard-tier Quest Board rewards, a 50% chance alongside Elite-tier Quest Board rewards, or a possible outcome of the every-5th-qualifying-run Diamond Trophy milestone. Not craftable at the altar.
entries.how_to_use: Consumed automatically when you open a Rare Crate from the Bag. Stacks freely.
entries.icon_hint: a small ornate key with a purple-tinted handle and a faint sparkle
entries.notes: Also documented, with the same facts, in crates-and-keys.json.

entries.name: Cosmetic Shard
entries.description: Craft cosmetics from these.
entries.how_to_get: A materials-pool roll in Small/Large Pocket Bags, a guaranteed roll in Common Crates, a large guaranteed roll in Rare Crates, and a possible Daily Chest item-slot roll.
entries.how_to_use: NOT CURRENTLY SPENDABLE ON ANYTHING: despite its description and its display name, no altar recipe currently in configuration actually consumes Cosmetic Shards as an ingredient. They are meant to fund a future 'shard shop' for buying smaller cosmetics directly (documented as planned-but-unbuilt in HubCore's docs/BAG_ITEMS_APPROVED.md), so right now they simply accumulate in the Bag with no way to spend them.
entries.icon_hint: a small glowing amethyst-colored crystal shard
entries.notes: Stacks without limit. This is a genuine gap between the item's flavor text ('Craft cosmetics from these') and the live altar recipes, which is why how_to_use flags it explicitly rather than repeating the flavor text as fact.

entries.name: Stardust
entries.description: For the cosmetics nobody else has.
entries.how_to_get: A rare bonus-pool roll from opening a Large Pocket Bag, part of a Rare Crate's guaranteed shard/dust roll, a materials-pool roll in Rare Crates, and a possible Daily Chest item-slot roll. Despite its config description ('Rare crates only'), Large Pocket Bags can also roll it.
entries.how_to_use: Spent as an ingredient at the Crafting Altar for two of the highest-tier cosmetic recipes: the Golden Crown (10 Stardust) and Angel Wings (16 Stardust).
entries.icon_hint: a small pile of fine gold-white glittering dust

entries.name: Beta Ticket
entries.description: You were here before it was finished.
entries.how_to_get: Granted automatically on join, together with the Beta Tester tag, to anyone who connects before the beta cutoff date configured in NetworkCore. As of this catalogue that cutoff has not passed yet, so this is not a retroactive 'you were here early' check - it is a live date gate that fires on every join, meaning even a brand-new player joining today still receives it. It will stop being granted the moment the network passes that cutoff.
entries.how_to_use: A keepsake with no action button - it just sits in the Bag as proof you played before the cutoff date.
entries.icon_hint: a slightly worn paper ticket stub stamped with a star and the word BETA
entries.notes: Non-stackable, Legendary rarity - cannot be earned any other way. give() caps non-stackable items at one, so re-joining after the first grant is a harmless no-op.

open_questions: Whether Diamond Trophy, Elevator Chaos, Mace Crush and Survival will each grant their game item on a specific trigger (a boss kill, a floor cleared, a match win, etc.) is not yet decided in any config - today those items simply have no code path that grants them, so they only appear in the Bag as an uncollected collection-log entry.

A larger wave of new bag items (mostly cosmetics, plus two higher crate tiers, an Epic/Mythic key pair, and a shard shop to finally spend Cosmetic Shards on) is planned in HubCore's docs/BAG_ITEMS_APPROVED.md and is intentionally left out of this list since none of it exists in the live item registry yet.
Cosmetic Shard has no live sink at all right now - it is only ever gained, never spent by any current altar recipe. It exists purely to fund the planned-but-unbuilt shard shop.
